# openwrt_rpcd (Resource)

rpcd daemon settings (`config rpcd`).

Manages a `rpcd` section in `/etc/config/rpcd`. This section normally exists on a stock router: creating the resource adopts it (renaming an anonymous section to `section`), and destroying the resource only removes it from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `socket` (String) ubus socket path. (UCI option `socket`.)
- `timeout` (Number) Call timeout in seconds. (UCI option `timeout`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
